svg.title: first_event_by_tray: written by tray assignment, read by AGV assignment
svg.desc: Left: tray assignment fills the map with the first move of each tray. Right: AGV assignment uses it so an AGV does not drive through a tray's starting node before the tray has left; using the last move would close a cycle.

g.text: Tray ids, nodes and the AGV chain are illustrative. The rule is from agv_assignment.cpp (OrderAfterTraysOnPath, called by ScheduleAgvMoveToPickup) and tray_assignment.cpp (ChainTrayEvent).

g.text: first_event_by_tray: written by tray assignment, read by AGV assignment

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The map answers one question: when has this tray left the node it started on? The first move is the answer, and the only safe one: later moves of the same tray may come after the very AGV move that has to wait.
